answer: The craft proves the agent: Licensed potter glaze mixing log with master craftsman endorsement is the craft, and the craft is learned through 3-year apprenticeship, 172 supervised kiln loads, trade test, guild dues. Every honest agent brings a karst from the bench, a trellis from the purse, and a marble from the hall, and the panel checks all three before a word is graded. One pair of honest hands outweighs a thousand printed at midnight. Cloning is charged per head: 313 fakes need 313 proofs at 130 POA each, a standing bill of 40690 POA.
